title: Release Env Fingerprint
user: Engineers shipping the same service through local, CI, staging, and production environments who need to find missing, extra, or differently resolved configuration without revealing values.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that captures a name/type/presence fingerprint from an approved command, compares signed fingerprints by environment, and enforces rules such as required prefixes, endpoint host allowlists, and value hashes for explicitly non-secret values.
constraints: Never persist raw environment values; salt hashes per project; explicitly classify allowlisted non-secrets; support POSIX shell and GitHub Actions first.
